name: whois-mcp-server
description: Look up domain registration, check registry record status, fetch DNS records, and resolve IPs and ASNs over RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Look up domain registration, check registry record status, fetch DNS records, and resolve IPs and ASNs over RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Six RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS tools: whois_lookup_domain (registry record and optional registrar contact detail), whois_check_availability (registered/not_found/unknown record status; no registration eligibility guarantee), whois_get_dns (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, PTR), whois_lookup_ip (netblock CIDRs, org, abuse contact, PTR outcome), whois_lookup_asn (ASN to org/RIR), and whois_get_dossier (domain triage). IANA bootstrap selects the RDAP server; no API keys required. Runs over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
